desc:
Ever wondered what it would be like to swim in a giant bowl of cereal? Now you can! 😂

Jump into a HUGE bowl and choose your favorite cereal to swim, splash, and play in! 🍓🍫🌈

🥣 Choose your cereal — Pick from tons of delicious cereal types!
🏊 SWIM IN THE MILK — Explore a giant bowl filled with milk and cereal!
🍪 Collect cereal pieces — Find hidden treats and collect them all!
⭐ Earn rewards — Play, explore, and unlock new cereals and fun items!
🌈 Discover crazy bowls — Who knows what you'll find floating around?
👑 Become the ultimate cereal swimmer!
Which cereal will YOU swim in?
🍫 Chocolate? 🍓 Strawberry? 🌈 Rainbow? 🧁 Something totally crazy?

Join now and dive into the world's biggest bowl of cereal! 🥣🏊‍♂️
Note- The update will be delayed due to a problem with Roblox Studio, I will do a big update as soon as the problem is fixed!
